title: The Distance tab
description: The fade curve with the players you hear, presets and a Listen button.

title: The Walls tab
description: How a voice sounds behind glass, leaves, wood, dirt, stone, iron and wool.

title: The Effects tab
description: Echo, water, rain and sound round corners, with what applies around you right now.

title: The HUD
description: Who is talking, how far, behind a wall or whispering, and how many hear you.

title: The Server tab
description: For admins: profile, walls, game rules and zones, saved on the server right away.

title: The change log
description: Every change to the server's settings, ten a page, filtered by player, with undo.

title: Settings locked by the server
description: When a server enforces its profile, the locked controls show a padlock.
